main_text.p: Samaritanorum Pentateuchum, quem transactis mensibus, ut typis mandaretur, ad te miseram, adhuc mihi non fuisse remissum; consulto enim putabam id fieri, nempe ut is, usque ad extremum operis absolutionem tibi inservire posset, tantum hortantibus amicis, ut alia quaedam, in eundem finem in Gallias allegarem, respondi, me, priusquam alia mitterem, velle inspicere, procuratæ antea Pentateuchi impressionis diu expectatum exitum: qva nimirum sui, merqve[?] felicitate liber iste prodiret, atque ex illius fato de reliquis postea decreturum. Nam de futuro ad votum hujus libri eventu non de festinata exemplaris restitutione, me summopere sollicitum fuisse, & qvousqve id intuear, mirum in modum continuo futurum, sincere fateor. Amplissimus vir nostriqve studiosissimus Dominus Perescius, qvi mittendi olim ad te Pentateuchi primus certe mihi auctor extitit, optime novit, qvis sit meus hac super re sensus: qvanto scilicet ardeam desiderio vulgationis hujus Pentateuch

page.notes: Doubtful readings: "merqve" (line 12) is uncertain; the reading may be "meiqve". The word "sui" may also be "fui". The word "Perescius" was printed with long s and is rendered with plain s. The text ends mid-word ("Pentateuch") and continues on the next page; the catchword "à te" is the first word of the following page. No marginal notes are visible. The margins show only scan noise and the edge of the neighbouring page, which are omitted.
